title: Paul McCartney live: Rogers Place, Edmonton | 2018
content:
Paul McCartney performed at Rogers Place in Edmonton, Canada, on 30 September 2018.

It was the fourth show of the Freshen Up Tour, which lasted for 39 dates between September 2018 and July 2019. This concert was seen by 15,310 fans.

Last show in Canada for a while, thanks all you Canadians! We hope you had a ball. We did!!!! Love from Paul and the gang #FreshenUpTour pic.twitter.com/dp0KAFsqSv

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) October 2, 2018

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).
